'''Fort Barrow''' was [[Darth Malgus]]' base of operations in the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Galactic War]], protected by many of Malgus' [[New Empire|followers]]. In [[3640 BBY]], it was invaded during the [[Battle of Ilum]].
